sam: kicked off an 8% canary for v3.0.1 in us-east at 09:03. deploy-bot acked. :rocket:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: release=v3.0.1 stage=canary target=8% initiated_by=sam
ria: noticing working set climb on canary infer nodes ~40MB -> 180MB when serving long prompts
devon: small number of client retries on large-context workloads, ~0.3% 429/backpressure
priya: noted in release notes: disk-backed KV fallback + op fusion. tagging docs for opt-in note
sam: canaries have cache.mode=fallback enabled — expected mem profile differs
ria: 5xx count stable. p95 spikes when token length >1k, correlates with working set climb
priya: propose pausing to investigate eviction thresholds and pin stable route to v3.0.0
sam: pausing now. deploy-bot, pause shift and pin stable -> v3.0.0
deploy-bot: Traffic shift paused by sam at 09:07. Current traffic: canary=8%, stable=92%. Pin action: routing.stable -> v3.0.0 (temporary)
devon: keeping canary pods up for traces; uploading logs to s3://redwood-debug/canary/1733333333/logs.tar.gz
ria: adding 20m alert suppression for p95 to reduce noisy pages
priya: prepping emergency patch branch in case we need to flip flag quickly
devon: rollback plan sketched: 1) scale canary to 1% 2) unpin stable if safe 3) flip kv fallback flag in hotfix if needed
priya: infra heads-up: kernel tweaks need ~15m coord; pinging infra channel
sam: reconvene 09:30 for stop/go. owners: ria metrics, devon traces, priya rollout ops
ria: ack. running histogram split by token-length buckets :mag:
devon: ack. sampling traces at 50% for canary request ids
priya: patch branch ready if needed: https://git.redwood/release/v3.0.1-hotfix-kvflag
deploy-bot: Reminder: change-window for broad rollout 10:00-12:00 EDT. Rollback inside window requires eng-leads + oncall approval
sam: if all clear at 09:30 we'll ramp to 5% then 25% with strict gates. if mem climb persists we'll rollback to v3.0.0 and open incident
priya: traces & capture links posted, will update with triage notes
sam: closing thread until stop/go. will post explicit GO or ROLLBACK at 09:30. :white_check_mark:
